t_advice_summary_textbox.text: red, brown and purple are red basket, and yellow, light blue and green are yellow basket. when the counts get low on one basket switch to other color.

vb_textbox.text: the red, purple and brown gnomes give you the red basket, the yellow, blue and green give you the yellow basket. Once you figure out what basket gives you more mushroom click on those colored gnomes associated with basket. Once the count gets low, switch colors as the forest will restock mushrooms.
